title: fix(cli): retire `generate --output`, which was declared, documented and never read (objectui#11476)
body:
Fixes #11476

Clause-②: yes

## What

`objectui generate` declared `--output DIR` (documented default `schemas/`), and the CLI docs listed it. The action never read it. It calls `generate(type, name)`, and the generator writes in its own per-type layout under the current directory. Triage ruled the flag retired at once, with no alias window (ruling comment `5955124315` on the card). This PR:

- removes the `--output` option line from the `generate` command in `packages/cli/src/cli.ts`;
- removes the `--output` row from the `generate` flag table in `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx`. Only that row is touched, region-disjoint from draft PR objectui#11069, which edits the same file elsewhere;
- drops `--output` from the `generate` row of the "exposes the documented flags" table in `cli-bin.test.ts`, and adds three built-CLI pins;
- adds `.changeset/11476-retire-generate-output.md` (`@object-ui/cli` `minor`, BREAKING banner, a FROM → TO line, a Clause-② line).

No new refusal code was needed. The program sets no `allowUnknownOption`, `passThroughOptions` or `allowExcessArguments`, so commander's default refusal applies once the option is undeclared. I measured this on the BASE build before touching anything: `g page Probe --bogus custom/` exits 1 with `error: unknown option '--bogus'` and writes nothing.

Serial: PR objectui#11473 (the same generator, triage's named predecessor) landed as `5429e6c74` and is an ancestor of this branch (`merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0). `generate.ts` is not edited here.

## Contract notes

- **The accept set narrows (Clause-② yes).** The published `objectui` bin's `generate` command no longer accepts `--output`. FROM `objectui generate TYPE NAME --output DIR` (exit 0, flag ignored, file written in the per-type layout) TO a non-zero exit with commander's unknown-option error and nothing written. There is no alias, no deprecation window and no silent accept.
- **Unchanged.** Without the flag, `generate` writes exactly where it wrote before: `pages/NAME.json` for a page, `objects/NAME.json` for an object, `plugins/NAME/` for a plugin. No exported symbol of `@object-ui/cli` moves, because `cli.ts` is the bin entry and not part of the package's `exports`.
- **`--from SOURCE` is untouched.** It is a separate declared-but-unimplemented flag (see Acceptance notes), and not this card's.

## Pins

They live in `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts` and run through the built `dist/cli.js`, under `generate refuses the retired --output flag (objectui#11476)`:

1. `exits non-zero naming --output as an unknown option, and writes nothing`: runs `g page Probe --output custom/` in an empty temp directory. It asserts a non-zero exit, that stderr names the kind (`unknown option`) and the option (`--output`), and that the directory stays empty.
2. `still writes pages/NAME.json when the flag is absent`: the control the refusal is read against. It is the same command without the flag, and it asserts exit 0 and a tree of exactly `pages` and `pages/probe.json`.
3. `does not list --output in generate --help`: carries a lit control that the help text read is generate's own (`--from SOURCE` is listed).

## Reverse verification

I wrote each prediction down before its run.

- **BASE leg.** The new pins ran against the dist built from BASE `2c0ddf226`, before the fix was built. Predicted: pins 1 and 3 red, pin 2 green. Observed: `Tests  2 failed | 41 passed (43)`. Pin 1 failed on `expected +0 not to be +0`, with stdout `✓ Generated page schema: …/pages/probe.json`. Pin 3 failed on `expected 'Usage: objectui generate|g [options] …' not to match /--output\b/`.
- **Ablation.** The fix was committed first, as `c0dad4b52`. The option line was then planted back through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, with its restore trap. Anchor count went `x1 -> x0`, replacement `x0 -> x1`, blob `6b9bbbbf7eb6 -> 3b73365ae916`, which is byte-for-byte the BASE blob of `cli.ts`. Mutant source marker 1; CLI rebuilt; mutant `dist/cli.js` marker 1. Predicted the same two reds. Observed: `Tests  2 failed | 41 passed (43)`, failing on the same two names.
- **Restore.** The tool ran `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path. Blob after restore equals the HEAD blob (`6b9bbbbf7eb6`), `git diff HEAD` is empty and `git status --porcelain` is empty. CLI rebuilt; restored `dist/cli.js` marker 0; `Tests  43 passed (43)`.
- **Void first attempt, not counted.** The first ablation attempt did nothing. Its replacement still contained the anchor, so `ablation-replace` refused it (anchor count `1 -> 1`) and restored before the wrapped leg ran. I re-anchored across the line boundary and ran it again; that is the run above.
- objectstack's `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` is rooted in the objectstack tree, so I proved the dist side by hand: `grep -c` of the option spelling in `packages/cli/dist/cli.js`, on both legs.

## Tests and gates

Everything below ran on final head `c0dad4b52`.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli build`: exit 0. The dist carries 0 hits of the `--output DIR` spelling, against 1 for the `--from SOURCE` control.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` (`tsc --noEmit`): exit 0. `--listFiles` shows it covers both `cli.ts` and `cli-bin.test.ts`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/` plus four cross-package readers of `cli.mdx` or of the generator (`page-node-headings-drawn-11436`, `toc-anchor-parity`, `nested-page-children-11223`, `body-dialect-census`): `Test Files  28 passed (28)`, `Tests  497 passed (497)`.
- The built-CLI reproduction from the card: `node packages/cli/dist/cli.js g page Probe --output custom/` exits 1 with `error: unknown option '--output'`, and the directory stays empty. The same command without the flag exits 0 and writes `pages/probe.json`.
- `pnpm docs:check-links`: `Links are valid across 17 scan roots.`
- `pnpm check:doc-fences`: ✅
- `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit`: `all adjudicated … all present.`
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: ✅ OK
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0`
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: ✅. `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: ✅. `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: ✅
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` (report-only): two pending changesets name a file this change touches. `7658-toc-code-span-anchor-parity` names `cli.mdx` for its headings, and `7694-chart-series-chart-type-alias-refusal` names `cli.ts` as the home of `objectui validate`. I re-read both paragraphs, and both are still true.
- `check-doc-component-types.mjs` and `check-doc-example-ids.mjs`: ✅
- **ESLint, as a proved narrowing.** ① Population: CI lints this package through `turbo run lint`, which runs `@object-ui/cli`'s `eslint src` against the root `eslint.config.js` (the package has no config of its own). I ran that same `eslint src`. ② `--format json` counts 51 files linted, equal to the 51 tracked ts/js files under `packages/cli/src`. It reports 0 errors and 5 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all in untouched files; both edited files read 0/0. ③ Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`) and no import-graph plugin, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it does not touch. `cli.mdx` and the changeset sit outside every eslint `files` glob. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- Not run, and why: `check-doc-snippet-types` (the docs edit removes one table row and touches no fenced block), and the full `pnpm test` (CI's).
- `origin/main` has since moved by PR objectui#11481 (sidebar, shadcn patches, an e2e spec), which shares no file with this diff. I did not merge it, because the merge queue rebuilds on current `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- `--from SOURCE` on the same command, measured on the BASE build: `g page Probe --from openapi.yaml` prints "not yet implemented", exits 0 and writes nothing. Its docs row marks it *experimental*. It is a separate declared-not-enforced flag. It is left untouched here and reported to the dispatching seat.

Implemented by the os-dev agent dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`.
